benchmark.name: ChipBench v2 — Verilog Pass@1

summary.en: ChipBench evaluates generation of structurally complex, simulation-verified Verilog hardware modules.
summary.zh: ChipBench 评估模型生成结构复杂、通过仿真验证的 Verilog 硬件模块的能力。

task_format.en: Given a hardware specification and supplied interfaces, the model writes a complete implementation for one of 44 modules.
task_format.zh: 模型根据硬件规格和提供的接口，为 44 个模块之一生成完整实现。

explanation.en: Pass@1 estimates one-sample compile-and-test success; the headline is the unweighted mean across CPU-IP, hierarchical, and self-contained categories.
explanation.zh: Pass@1 估计单次生成通过编译和全部测试的概率；headline 是 CPU-IP、层次模块和独立模块三个类别的非加权平均。

unavailable: T80: not included in the first vertical slice
benchmark.date_policy: Primary lifecycle time uses the earliest available date among evaluation/run time, model release time, and the earliest recorded score-publication time for the same observation. Plot dates and T50/T80/T90 are clipped at benchmark release, so lifecycle durations are never negative; original dates remain preserved for provenance.

test-of-time.rule: T50 >= 12 months OR T90 >= 24 months, including censoring

still-frontier.rule: right-censored T50 AND normalized progress < 50% AND coverage not low

recently-saturated.rule: T90 crossing within 3 months of snapshot
